headline: 3 killed, 20 injured in Tangail bus-truck collision last night
summary: A head-on collision between a bus and a truck in Tangail's Madhupur upazila resulted in multiple casualties. All victims were bus passengers.
details: At least three people were killed and over 20 injured in a head-on collision between a bus and a truck in Tangail's Madhupur upazila last night. The incident occurred around 10:00 PM in the Raktipara area.
All deceased and injured individuals were passengers of the bus, according to Madhupur Fire Service Team Leader Borhan Ali. The identities of the deceased have not yet been confirmed.
Fire service personnel, assisted by locals, conducted a rescue operation. They transported the injured to Madhupur Upazila Health Complex for immediate medical attention.

Eight of the injured are currently receiving treatment at Madhupur Upazila Health Complex. Critically injured victims have been referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital and other facilities for specialized care.
The bodies of the three deceased are being held at the hospital as authorities work to identify them. Madhupur Police Station Inspector (Investigation) Anwar Hossain confirmed these efforts.
caption:
Three people died and over 20 were injured in a devastating bus-truck collision in Tangail's Madhupur last night. All casualties were bus passengers.

All deceased and injured individuals were passengers of the bus, according to Madhupur Fire Service Team Leader Borhan Ali. The identities of the deceased have not yet been confirmed.

Fire service personnel, assisted by locals, conducted a rescue operation. They transported the injured to Madhupur Upazila Health Complex for immediate medical attention.

Eight of the injured are currently receiving treatment at Madhupur Upazila Health Complex. Critically injured victims have been referred to Mymensingh Medical College Hospital and other facilities for specialized care.

The bodies of the three deceased are being held at the hospital as authorities work to identify them. Madhupur Police Station Inspector (Investigation) Anwar Hossain confirmed these efforts.

headline: Iran attacks US bases in Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan in retaliation
summary: The strikes come as a direct response to previous US attacks, escalating tensions in the Middle East.
details: Iran has launched attacks targeting US military bases located in Kuwait, Bahrain, and Jordan.
The Iranian government stated that these operations were carried out in retaliation for previous attacks conducted by the United States.
The strikes mark a significant escalation in regional tensions between the two nations.
International observers are closely monitoring the situation as the risk of further conflict grows in the Middle East.
